SATURDAY 18 JULY (announced):
- Lebanese President Joseph Aoun will visit the White House to meet Trump - the first visit by a Lebanese head of state since Michel Sleiman met Obama in 2009. Aoun left for Washington; meeting expected next week (Tuesday per The National).
- Agenda: strengthen the ceasefire, secure Israel's withdrawal from southern Lebanon, "restore security and stability," extend Lebanese state authority across all territory, and seek a reconstruction/relief package.
- Follows a round of US-mediated Lebanon-Israel talks in Rome; sides agreed next steps for "pilot zones" in southern Lebanon where Israeli troops would begin withdrawing and the Lebanese army take over security.
- Israeli military struck a Hezbollah cell near Tebnit in southern Lebanon on Saturday after identifying a Hezbollah drone; new Israeli attacks reported on two towns in Tyre and Nabatieh regions.
- Hezbollah has rejected the framework agreement and refused calls to disarm.
- At least 4,250 people killed in Lebanon since March; about one million displaced (The National, citing devastating Israeli strikes).
